'''Polarpaw''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Snowcub]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Blizzgrizz]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Polarpaw is gradually learning to discern the distinct smell of fish, the flow of currents, and movement patterns beneath the ice. Although sometimes the prey turns out to be seaweed, random sticks of wood, and even Polarpaw's own shadow, this is all part of the master plan. At least, that's what Polarpaw would tell you."

Polarpaw is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An adolescent polar bear that holds a blue and pink fish in both arms. Its snout, paws, ears, and tail are cyan.

Polarpaw's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of the fish to maroon, and the cyan accents becomes peach in color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Snowcub's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Blizzgrizz]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Polarpaw to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x2000) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (Use Bullet Coin x200,000).
